# Kavy Agrawal — Personal Portfolio

## Who is Kavy Agrawal?

Kavy Agrawal is a full-stack developer and SaaS architect based in India, specializing in building premium web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, and scalable SaaS platforms.

## Skills & Expertise

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Express.js, GraphQL
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase
- **Cloud/DevOps**: AWS, Docker, Netlify
- **Payments**: Stripe, Razorpay, PayU — custom gateway integration
- **AI**: OpenAI API integration, LangChain

## Tagline

"Turning Vision Into Reality"

## Services

Kavy Agrawal is available for:
- Full-stack web application development
- SaaS platform architecture and development
- Flutter mobile app development
- Custom payment gateway integration
- AI integration (OpenAI/LangChain)
- Technical consultation
